tagline: On one phone or on everyone's own. Free, no ads, no account needed.
footer1: Everything runs in your browser. Pass the phone around: look at your card, cover it, hand it on.
footer2: Home-made and not affiliated with the app Splash.
g.impostor.d: Everyone knows the word. One person doesn't. Bluffing wins.
g.spy.d: Everyone is at the same place. Only the spy is in the dark.
g.wolf.d: At night the wolves hunt, by day the village hunts them.
g.wouldrather.d: One question, everybody points at one person at the same time.
g.bomb.d: Name a topic item, pass the phone, don't get caught.
pl.title: Players
pl.label: Add names
pl.count: {n} of 20. Alex, Sam, Kim and Jo are example names, remove them any time.
pass.only: Only you look at the screen now.
imp.hint: With {n} players up to {max} are possible.
imp.roleText: You don't know the word. Listen closely and play along.
imp.wordText: Don't say it outright. Find out who doesn't know it.
imp.rules: In turns, everyone says a word or a sentence that fits the secret word without giving it away. The impostor tries not to stand out. Then you vote.
spy.hint: The timer starts once everyone has seen their card.
spy.roleText: You don't know the place. Find out where you are without getting caught.
spy.placeText: Find the spy, but don't give the place away too clearly.
spy.rules: Ask each other questions about the place without naming it. The spy may guess the place at any time. If you catch the spy, you win.
wolf.more: This selection needs more players (at least 5, and at least one plain villager).
wolf.tooFew: Too few players for these roles.
wolf.reader: One person reads aloud and keeps their eyes open. They still play.
role.werewolf.t: At night you agree on a victim. By day you act innocent.
role.seer.t: Each night you may check one person. The game shows you whether they are a werewolf.
role.witch.t: You have one healing potion and one poison. Use each once per game.
role.hunter.t: When you die, you take one person of your choice with you.
role.cupid.t: On the first night you pick two lovers. If one dies, the other dies of grief.
role.guardian.t: Each night you protect one person from the werewolves. Never the same person two nights in a row.
role.girl.t: You may peek during the werewolf phase. Don't get caught, or the wolves take you.
role.idiot.t: If the village votes you out, you survive but lose your vote for the rest of the game.
role.elder.t: You survive the first werewolf attack. If the village votes you out, all special roles lose their powers.
role.villager.t: You have no power. Talk, listen and find the werewolves.
wolf.n1: It is night. Everyone closes their eyes and stays silent.
wolf.nCupid: Cupid wakes up and points at two people. Tap both on the shoulder, then they open their eyes, see each other and go back to sleep. Cupid sleeps too.
wolf.nGuardian: The guardian wakes up and points at the person to protect tonight. Then the guardian goes back to sleep.
wolf.nWolves: The werewolves wake up, silently point at their victim and go back to sleep.
wolf.nSeer: The seer wakes up and points at someone. The narrator gives a thumbs up for werewolf or a thumbs down for not. Then the seer sleeps again.
wolf.nWitch: The witch wakes up. Show her the night's victim. She may save them and may poison someone else. Then she sleeps again.
wolf.d1: Day breaks. Everybody wakes up. The night's victims are out and reveal their roles.
wolf.dHunter: If the hunter died, they shoot at a person of their choice right now.
wolf.dVote: The village discusses and votes. The person with the most votes is out. The village wins when all werewolves are dead. The wolves win when they are as many as everyone else.
wq.rules: On three, everybody points at one person at the same time. Whoever gets the most fingers takes a sip of water or tells a story about it.
bomb.rules: Whoever holds the bomb names something that fits the topic and passes the phone on. No repeats. Whoever holds it when it explodes loses.
bomb.say: Name something, then pass it on.
acc.title: Account
acc.guestInfo: Accounts are optional. As a guest everything works. With an account your player names and language are saved on this server and follow you to other devices.
acc.toLogin: Already have an account? Sign in
acc.mustChange: Please choose a new password before you continue.
acc.deleteHint: Deletes your account and saved data. Enter your password to confirm.
adm.title: Users
adm.temp: Temporary password for {name}: {pw}. They must change it at the next login.
err.bad_username: Use 3 to 24 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.
err.registration_closed: Registration is closed on this server.
err.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
err.user_limit: This server has reached its account limit.

onlineDesc: Everyone uses their own phone. Create a room, share the code.
g.never.d: Read the line. Everyone who has done it takes a sip or loses a point.
g.truth.d: Pick truth or dare for the player whose turn it is.
g.whoami.d: Hold the phone to your forehead, the others give hints. 60 seconds.
g.sketch.d: One draws, the others guess. Online only.
never.rules: If it applies to you: take a sip or lose a point. Be honest.
who.rules: Hold the phone to your forehead, screen facing the others. They describe the word without saying it.
on.title: Play online
on.name: Your name
on.share: Friends enter this code under “Play online”.
on.langNote: Words and questions use the room language ({lang}).
on.err.too_few: Not enough players for this game.
on.err.not_host: Only the host can do that.
on.err.room_not_found: Room not found. Check the code.
on.err.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Try again later.
ww.lover: You are in love with {name}. If one dies, so does the other.
ww.sleep: Night {n}. Close your eyes and wait …
ww.guardian: Guardian: who do you protect tonight?
ww.seer: Seer: whose role do you want to see?
ww.idiot: {name} is the village idiot and survives, but can't vote anymore.
ww.hunter: Hunter: you died. Take someone with you!
ww.out: You are out, but you can keep watching.
g.spectrum.d: One knows a secret spot between two opposites, the others find it. Online only.
sp.you: You know the spot. Give a hint out loud, without naming the numbers.
sp.other: {name} gives a hint. Place the slider where you think the spot is.
sp.locked: Locked in. Waiting for the others …
adm.customHint: One entry per line. Added to the built-in lists in every language.
g.boxes.d: Draw lines, close boxes, get another turn. Most boxes wins.
bx.limit: 2 to 4 players. Bigger boards take longer.
bx.local: Passing the phone around with {n} players. Tap between two dots to draw a line.
voice.label: Voice
wolf.deadRole: Nobody with this role is alive. Pretend anyway so nobody can tell, then continue.
nar.night: Night falls. Everyone close your eyes.
nar.cupid: Cupid, open your eyes and choose two lovers. Then go back to sleep.
nar.guardian: Guardian, open your eyes and choose someone to protect. Then go back to sleep.
nar.wolves: Werewolves, open your eyes and choose a victim. Then go back to sleep.
nar.seer: Seer, open your eyes and point at someone to look at. Then go back to sleep.
nar.witch: Witch, open your eyes. Do you want to use a potion? Then go back to sleep.
nar.hunter: The hunter was killed and takes someone with them. Choose now.
nar.vote: Discuss and vote. Who should be eliminated?
nar.idiot: {name} is the village idiot and survives, but can no longer vote.
wq.rulesAB: Everybody decides: A or B. Count hands and discuss why.
imp.whoHint: Talk it over, then pick the player the group suspects most.
imp.suggest: Suggestion: ask everyone one more question about the word before you decide.
imp.caught: Caught! The group found the impostor.
bomb.motionHint: Just hand the phone on. A quick jolt passes the bomb, no tapping.
bomb.motionPass: Hand the phone to the next player.
wolf.narr.d: Someone who isn't in the player list narrates and doesn't play. They hold the phone and read the text out loud, the voice stays off.
wolf.narrOn: A narrator reads the text aloud.
imp.tipOpt.d: The impostor sees the topic and the first letter of the word.
g.duel.d: Two players, one phone, sitting opposite each other. Quick duels.
duel.tug.d: Tap as fast as you can and win the whole screen.
duel.react.d: Tap when the screen turns green. Too early and you lose.
duel.rps.d: Both choose in secret, then it is revealed.
g.quad.d: Up to four players around one phone. Fast tapping games.
quad.hint: Two players sit at the bottom, two at the top. Everyone gets their own corner.
quad.react.d: Tap when it turns green. Tap early and you are out.
g.chain.d: Write, draw, describe: the chain gets funnier with every player. Online only.
ch.write: Write a sentence for the others to draw.
ch.placeholder: e.g. a dog on a skateboard
ch.describe: What do you see? Describe this drawing.
g.hangman.d: Guess the word letter by letter, taking turns. Too many wrong letters and it's over.
hm.ownHint: One of you types a secret word, the others guess.
hm.ownTitle: Type the secret word. The others must not look.
g.solo.d: Play alone: word guessing, memory and a reaction test.
solo.wordle.d: Guess the hidden five-letter word. Green is right, yellow is in the wrong spot.
solo.memory.d: Find all matching pairs in as few moves as you can.
solo.reaction.d: Tap as soon as the screen turns green. Five rounds.
diff.label: Difficulty
g.chess.d: The classic. Against a bot or a friend on one phone.
fun.night.1: Everybody close your eyes. Peeking is for amateurs.
fun.night.2: Sleep tight, and keep an eye on your neighbour. With your eyes closed, of course.
fun.dawn.1: Rise and shine, the village. Mostly.
fun.dawn.2: Good morning! Check your limbs, everyone.
fun.noDeaths.1: Nobody died. The wolves clearly skipped breakfast.
fun.died.1: Please observe a moment of silence. Then start pointing fingers.
fun.died.2: A tragic loss. Their snoring will be missed.
fun.vote.1: Time to vote. Point at someone with confidence, evidence is optional.
fun.vote.2: Democracy time! Choose wisely, or at least loudly.
fun.elim.1: The village has spoken. Bold choice.
fun.elim.2: And out they go. No hard feelings, it's only a game.
fun.tie.2: Nobody wins the vote. Very diplomatic of you.
fun.win.1: Well played, everyone. Now stop accusing each other.
fun.win.2: Game over. Friendships may now resume.
